errors.evidence: The description omits the closing parenthesis from the x-axis category label, which should be "Бедни (след социалните трансфери)".

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors to years. The correct colors are: 2016 (синьо/blue), 2017 (оранжево/orange), 2018 (сиво/grey), 2019 (жълто/yellow), and 2020 (светлосиньо/light blue). The description lists the wrong colors for 2018 (жълто instead of сиво), 2019 (кафяво instead of жълто), and 2020 (синьо instead of светлосиньо).
This is awkward phrasing. A clearer way to say this would be "Височината на стълбовете" (The height of the bars).
The description states that the bar for 2016 in the category "Бедни (преди социалните трансфери)" reaches approximately 49.0%. However, the bar is clearly positioned at about 45.5%.
